title: OKX sign up: where the referral code goes

lines.show: You enter an OKX referral code on the first sign-up screen, before you finish registration.
Tap Sign up and add your email or phone number.
Look for the referral or invite code line. It may be folded as optional.
Open it and type the code.
The code for this video is XOACPQFC.
That's the letter O, not a zero.
The website works the same way.
Type the address yourself instead of clicking an ad, then open the code field.
Once the account is created, the field is gone, so add the code first.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, type XOACPQFC on the first sign-up screen.
